PRE-DRAFT — Firefox Mobile ORGANIC MAU forecast through 2027

A forecast of Firefox Mobile monthly active users (MAU) from 2026-10-09 through 2027-12-31, for the four mobile apps together and each on its own, in Glean telemetry terms. Mobile telemetry has always been Glean, so the model trains on the real history from 2020-12-31: nothing is translated or simulated. The number to read is the raw daily MAU on 2027-12-15, the same statistic as the desktop package. It is the production mobile model with its October 2026 settings except a stiffer, later-bending trend (changepoint prior scale 0.0065, changepoint range 0.87), chosen so the forecast neither ignores 2026 nor extrapolates it. Organic only. Firefox Android's history is scaled to its organic share before the model sees it, using client-level paid/organic attribution (paid = acquired through a Play Store campaign; 21.3% of Firefox Android MAU on 2026-10-09); the other three apps carry no paid acquisition. Nothing paid is added back: these curves are organic MAU, history rows included, and the marketing team forecasts paid separately. Total mobile MAU is organic plus marketing's paid curve, never this file alone.

Pre-draft. Not yet backtested (the history is long enough to do so). Data treatments: the 2026 Iran internet shutdown (Iran's MAU over 2026-02-28..2026-06-21 is replaced in the training data by a counterfactual, so the model does not learn the outage as seasonality; the forecast then carries Iran as the model sees it). One further provisional data treatment: in India and Indonesia, where organic Firefox Android outgrew the same country's Firefox iOS during the 2026 high spend period in a way consistent with paid installs being counted as organic, organic history from 2026-04-01 is capped at the country's own Firefox iOS growth (440,081 MAU removed on 2026-10-09, 0.9% of the world figure). This is under review with the marketing data-science team and may be reversed. No head- or tailwinds. Use the curves for shape and magnitude; do not quote them as plan numbers.
Data in this package (the forecast itself): glean2027_mobile_organic_mau_forecast.csv — every day from 2020-12-31 to 2027-12-31, history and forecast, all apps and per app; glean2027_mobile_organic_mau_by_country.csv — the same per country; plots/ — the charts. Beside this package, glean2027_mau_desktop_and_mobile_organic.csv puts the desktop and organic mobile world curves side by side. Details in section 4.
Seam step -1.5%. The forecast opens 1.5% below the last week of history (46,986,901 on 2026-10-09, 7-day means). organic mobile MAU rose 41,746,738 → 46,986,901 over the five months before the seam (the high spend period) and the model deliberately does not carry all of that rise into 2027: closing the gap further would mean a 2027 slope above anything in the history. Read the first weeks as the model's view of the underlying level, not as a continuation of the last data point.

How far off could it be? Not yet measured for this metric. The same model's desktop MAU forecasts, run from eight past dates on a long history, missed the following year by 7% or less half the time and by 10% or less nine times in ten; around 51,545,439 that would be roughly ±3,608,181 to ±5,154,544. A mobile backtest is the next step and will replace this analogy.

4. How to use the files

  • glean2027_mobile_organic_mau_forecast.csv — one row per day from 2020-12-31 to 2027-12-31: date, data_type (training = history, forecast), then world, fenix_android, firefox_ios, focus_android, focus_ios. Values are the raw daily value of the rolling 28-day MAU, whole people. The world is the sum of the four apps (an app's column is empty before that app existed).
  • glean2027_mobile_organic_mau_by_country.csv — the same statistic per country (all apps) from 2024-01-01, plus world.
  • glean2027_mau_desktop_and_mobile_organic.csv (next to this package) — date, desktop_data_type, desktop_mau, mobile_data_type, mobile_organic_mau: the two world curves on one date grid. Do not add them: a person active on both devices is counted in both, and the mobile side is organic only.
  • plots/ — the charts above and one per app per year.
  • Read the 2027-12-15 row for the headline; read data_type to know where history ends (2026-10-09) and the forecast begins.
  • MAU is already a 28-day quantity, so take the daily value as is; do not smooth it again.

5. What is and is not in it

  • Mobile only: Firefox Android (Fenix), Firefox iOS, Focus Android, Focus iOS. No other mobile product (Klar, Firefox Lite, ...) is included, matching the regular monthly forecast's universe.
  • Real Glean history from 2020-12-31, as the dashboards count it. Iran's 2026 shutdown is bridged in the training data only.
  • No adjustments for planned launches, marketing, or known headwinds. The regular monthly mobile DAU forecast carries those; this one does not. Paid acquisition is excluded by construction (organic only); add the marketing team's paid forecast to get total.
  • Not yet backtested; the per-app split is affected by how the model reconciles tiles, so the all-apps figure is the one to quote.
